description:
Regular Meeting – Navratri Celebration | 14th October 2026

The Rotary Club of Mumbai Mulund South conducted its regular meeting on 14th October 2026, celebrating the auspicious occasion of Navratri with great enthusiasm and festive spirit.

The meeting beautifully blended Rotary fellowship with the vibrant traditions of Navratri. Members came together to celebrate the festival, enjoy the festive ambience, and strengthen the bonds of friendship and togetherness that form the foundation of Rotary.

The evening was filled with joy, music, and lively Garba and Dandiya celebrations, with members embracing the festive spirit in colourful traditional and fusion attire. The celebration provided a wonderful opportunity for members to unwind, connect, and create cherished memories together.

The gathering truly reflected the essence of Rotary fellowship, where service, friendship, culture, and celebration come together to strengthen the club’s unity and spirit.

It was a memorable evening.
